final: WITH sex_counts AS (SELECT p.SEX, COUNT(*) AS exam_count FROM Examination AS e JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID GROUP BY p.SEX), sex_shares AS (SELECT exam_count, 1.0 * exam_count / SUM(exam_count) OVER () AS share, AVG(exam_count) OVER () AS average_count FROM sex_counts) SELECT SUM(exam_count) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(exam_count - average_count) AS average_excess FROM sex_shares WHERE exam_count > average_count
